Maya Lopez: RCA for the KV-cache leak is live: https://redwood-internal.docs/rcas/kv-cache-leak-18026. Summary: cache ref counted incorrectly in hot-path causing slow-growing resident set -> autoscaler thrash, ~50m degraded capacity. OpsBot: RCA doc uploaded and pinned to #postmortems. Timeline, RCA, mitigating fixes, and test plans included. Priya Nair: Action items (owners + targets):
1) Hot-path refcount fix + unit tests — Jamal Ortiz — target 2026-03-26
2) Autoscaler cooldown increase for r4 pools (config + canary) — Samir Rao — target 2026-03-21
3) Add sustained-mem-growth alert (p95 growth over 2m) + runbook steps — Priya Nair — target 2026-03-22
4) Add regression e2e for KV eviction under concurrency — Eng Runtime — target 2026-04-05
5) Postmortem health-check script for canaries — Maya Lopez — target 2026-03-23

Jamal Ortiz: I'm on the refcount fix, local tests pass, pushing branch and opening PR today: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4571. Will request reviews from @eng-runtime. Samir Rao: I'll deploy autoscaler cooldown change behind a FF and run a 1-pool canary tomorrow morning. Will report results here. Alex Chen: Scheduling a 30m follow-up checkpoint: 2026-03-31 09:00 PT. Agenda: verify fix on canary, autoscaler behavior, alerting. Invites sent to @eng-runtime, @eng-sre, @product-reliability. OpsBot: Calendar event created and invites delivered. Samir Rao: Canary started, initial memory curve looks stable for the first 20m, posting graphs to the doc. Priya Nair: Please ACK once you've read the RCA and noted ownership. Reply with "ack". Maya Lopez: noted, marking action items as release-blocking until closed. :white_check_mark: Jamal Ortiz: ack
